final_coverage_assessment: Good-to-strong coverage of the core target fields. Confirmed in-window outbreaks with case counts, hospitalizations, and deaths: (a) Backyard Poultry May 2024 — 470 confirmed cases, 1 death, 48 states, illness onset Jan 1–Sep 4 2024 (CDC + CIDRAP); (b) Cucumbers June 2024 — CDC index page found, Salmonella Braenderup, Florida grower, recall issued (case counts not visible in snippet but page is surfaced for data collection); (c) Eggs Sep 2024 with illness onset May 23–Sep 13 2024 — 93 cases, 34 hospitalizations, 0 deaths, 12 states (CDC + CIDRAP). FoodNet 2024 preliminary data provides annual Salmonella surveillance totals. CDC 2024 multistate summary confirms 38 Salmonella outbreaks investigated. Gaps: cases_probable and cases_suspected fields remain largely uncovered (only 1 probable case noted in Bearded Dragons MMWR, which is outside the window); locality (sub-state) granularity absent; FDA/FSIS advisory pages with explicit case counts not surfaced; Fresh Basil April 2024 outbreak may have illness dates extending into May 2024 but no case counts visible in snippet.
final_trustworthiness_assessment: High trustworthiness for the primary candidates. CDC outbreak investigation pages (cdc.gov) are the gold-standard authoritative source for confirmed US Salmonella case counts, hospitalizations, and deaths. CIDRAP articles directly cite CDC figures and add corroborating detail (e.g., 1 death in Illinois for backyard poultry, illness onset dates through July 26 for egg-linked outbreak). FoodNet preliminary data is an official CDC surveillance product. The 50% duplicate rate in iteration 2 reflects search engine saturation of the CDC domain for this query space, not a quality concern. No low-trust or non-authoritative sources are being recommended as primary evidence.
